title: AcroMonk: A Minimalist Underactuated Brachiating Robot — physical elbow command, clipped feedforward and torque readback
g1_scope: R2 actuator input, closed-loop response and identification
evidence: Public files downloaded, schema and generating or consuming code inspected, numeric outputs recomputed.

queries.retention: Inspect experimental data, canonical producer and reader; avoid software-only, synthetic-only and video-only entries.

neighboring_searches: GitHub README queries: "series elastic actuator" data; "actuator" "dynamometer" robot; exoskeleton actuator test data; "torque tracking" actuator.

DataCite datasets, up to 100/query: "series elastic actuators"; "torque tracking"; "torque control" AND exoskeleton; "quasi-direct drive"; "actuator characterization"; titles.title:(actuator AND torque).

keys: AcroMonk: A Minimalist Underactuated Brachiating Robot
history.normalization: NFKD, Unicode alphanumeric casefold across text, decompressed gzip and tar member contents; matched all literal normalized aliases.

method: Cross-check the real-system logger: clipping and some sign transforms occur on the host before send_rad_command; the servo returns moteus.Register.TORQUE. In PD mode, both embedded gains are enabled and the feedforward torque is zero. For six newer files compare abs(command)-abs(clipped) > 1e-6 Nm; for two phase-labelled files use the logger mapping.
Perform a separate five-swing paper check using the max absolute elbow_meas_tau over each full BF_*_5x.csv against Table IV on page 7 of the versioned PDF.
findings: 9 trials contain 12,544 physical rows. Across six newer logs, one BF_tvlqr_1x row reduces magnitude 17.3997584 to 3 Nm; five BF_tvlqr_5x swing rows show reductions, with max original 10.762331 Nm and clipped magnitude 3 Nm.

For BF_pd_5x swing, all 2,896 host feedforward commands are zero; in 2,333 of those samples absolute servo readback exceeds 0.1 Nm. This is consistent with feedback actuation. Three five-maneuver logs recover the paper peak torque values within 0.00544 Nm.

Full paper section V reports 5/5 nominal single-BF success for each controller. With the 160 g box disturbance recovery was 5/5 PD, 4/5 TVLQR and 1/5 RL. Under 200 g added swing-arm mass both TVLQR and RL failed in 5/5. These are author-reported outcomes, distinct from the recomputed filename-specific command records.
bounds: Only two of nine files expose the phase flag. Three older schemas omit both host-feedforward fields. The available motor torque readback does not independently measure shaft torque. Reference minus readback is not tracking failure for an onboard PD feedback loop.

One time step in FB_pd_1x_.csv is non-increasing. No time differentiation performed. The paper reports perturbation tests; the nine available filenames do not identify individual perturbed trials or expose collision force.
The publicly archived Zenodo tag predates the analyzed revision; records serve as aliases / provenance only. All numeric tables refer to the Git commit in version.
raw_inputs: All nine CSVs under results/real_system/csvs; no simulation files.

steps: Create a temporary checkout: git clone --no-checkout https://github.com/dfki-ric-underactuated-lab/acromonk.git checkout
Compare CSV SHA-256 to derived_files. No robot hardware, ROS or source training environment required.
